claim.claim-text: 1. A body attachable unit for glucose measurement, comprising:

a housing, wherein a bottom surface of the housing is to contact a skin; a sensor unit installed inside the housing, wherein one end portion of the sensor unit outwardly protrudes from the housing; and a printed circuit board (PCB) disposed inside the housing, wherein another end portion of the sensor unit is configured to be disposed at distance from the PCB inside the housing.
2. The body attachable unit for glucose measurement of claim 1, wherein the sensor unit comprises:

a sensor body unit configured to contact to the PCB; and a sensor probe unit configured to extend from one side of the sensor body unit, having a bent shape, and outwardly protruding from the housing to be insertable into the body.

3. The body attachable unit for glucose measurement of claim 2, wherein a sensor supporting unit configured to support the sensor body unit to be spaced apart from an electric contact point of the PCB is disposed in the housing.

4. The body attachable unit for glucose measurement of any claim of claim 2, wherein the sensor body unit is configured to be moved under pressure and contact to the electric contact point of the PCB.

5. The body attachable unit for glucose measurement of any claim of claims 1 to 4, wherein a wireless communication chip configured to wireless communicate with an external terminal is installed at the PCB.
6. The body attachable unit for glucose measurement of any claim of claims 1 to 4, wherein a battery configured to supply power to the PCB is disposed in the housing.

7. The body attachable unit for glucose measurement of claim 6, wherein the PCB and the battery are separately arranged so that any area of the PCB and the battery projecting into the bottom surface of the housing do not overlap each other, and a contact terminal of the PCB is extended to the battery so that the PCB is electrically connected with the battery.
8. The body attachable unit for glucose measurement of claim 6, wherein a sensor guiding unit configured to support and guide the sensor probe unit is disposed in the housing.
